discovery: Fresh VPS deployment smoke test (<ip>) — /api/paper returned found:false for a PMID proven present in the index
what_went_wrong: api-requirements.txt (the declared deployment requirements) omits `pylance`; lancedb 0.39 no longer bundles the `lance` module, so tbl.to_lance() in api_server._lookup_paper raised ImportError
The exception is swallowed by the endpoint's broad `except Exception: return None`, masking the missing dep as a benign found:false
Mac Mini production works only because pylance was added there ad hoc (docs/api-server.md records this) — the requirements file never caught up
root_cause: Requirements file drifted from actual runtime needs; silent-exception path hid the failure instead of surfacing it
fix_applied: Installed pylance==12.0.0 in VPS venv → /api/paper found:true with full abstract
Appended `pylance` to local api-requirements.txt with explanatory comment
secondary_self_correction: During pre-deploy recon I misattributed missing modules/files (pandas, nltk, .cache/layer1_entities.json) from a misread traceback and narrated them as blockers; direct verification (md5 of uploaded api_server.py vs local, grep of RC modules, reading layer1_abstain.py) showed the RC imports cleanly with the shipped requirements. Lesson: verify failure claims against file hashes/greps before narrating them as findings.
detection_gap: Silent except in _lookup_paper; no readiness probe covering /api/paper after deploy
